slots.headline: 5 AI Side Hustles Making $5K Monthly
slots.body: Concrete revenue models, real weekly hours, and the exact customers to target. No fluff—just scalable income streams.

slots.title: The 2026 AI Income Map
slots.body: These five models need under 15 hours weekly. Each solves a painful B2B or premium B2C problem.

slots.title: AI Automation Agency
slots.body: Build no-code AI workflows for local service businesses. Charge $2K–$5K monthly retainers. Time: 10–15 hrs/week.

slots.title: AI Avatar Ad Agency
slots.body: Create synthetic spokesperson UGC for DTC brands using AI avatars. Productized packages start at $3K per campaign.

slots.title: Custom AI Agent Builder
slots.body: Deploy customer-support and lead-qualification AI agents for SaaS and e-commerce. Build fee plus monthly maintenance.

slots.title: Hyper-Niche AI Newsletter
slots.body: Curate AI tools for one vertical. Monetize via premium subs at $20/mo and niche sponsorships once you hit 5K readers.

slots.title: Fractional AI Consultant
slots.body: Advise startups on AI stack strategy and prompt engineering. High-ticket retainers averaging $4K–$6K per month.
